name: Kozukuri Shiyou yo Souma-kun ~Ecchi na Ko Demo Ii Desu ka?~
original_name: 子作りしようよ ソーマくん ～えっちな娘でもいいですか？～
source:
Souma is a young man who doesn’t like flashy things or things that stand out. His quiet life was turned on its head when a princess from another world came to his room. She told him that if he doesn’t have sex and make someone pregnant, then he will disappeared from this world. The girls around him become more assertive to save their dear Souma. During this short period left, will he be able to choose one of them and impregnate her?

[From [url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2014/05/02/may-2014-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
相马是一个不喜欢浮华或引人注目的东西的年轻人。当一位来自异世界的公主来到他的房间时，他平静的生活发生了翻天覆地的变化。她告诉他，如果他不发生性行为并让某人怀孕，那么他就会从这个世界上消失。他周围的女孩们为了拯救他们亲爱的素马而变得更加自信。在这短短的时间里，他能否选择其中之一，让她怀孕呢？

[来自[url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2014/05/02/may-2014-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
